keyPoseFirstWorkflow.summary: Lock readable fighting-game key poses before generating in-betweens or assembling runtime strips.
keyPoseFirstWorkflow.identityAnchor: approved Sable visual design and side-view style lock
keyPoseFirstWorkflow.stopLine: Do not create in-betweens until key poses pass visual identity and fighting-readability review.

specialFamilyKeyPoseSheets.readabilityGoal: void shard or compression reads from Sable's body pose before VFX.
phase lunge has a clear anticipation, travel, strike, and recovery silhouette.
void anchor reads as a deliberate planted/control pose, not idle with VFX.
ground rift has a low, grounded body action with VFX separated if needed.
vertical phase has a readable launch/reach pose and vertical action.
only begin after movement, normals, and specials are readable.

requirements: preserve Sable face, skin tone, hair, outfit, palette, silhouette, and body scale
keep anticipation, hit frame, follow-through, and recovery readable
keep large VFX separate when it would hide the body

spriteForgeValidationStep: technical validation for dimensions, alpha, frame counts, baseline, and metadata
visual consistency review against approved Sable design lock
reject missing, choppy, unreadable, identity-drifted, or VFX-only rows
previewHarnessCheck: test in the Sable preview harness first
verify every movement, normal, special, reaction, knockdown, and getup visually differs from idle or walk
